name: tangible/populater
description: WordPress plugin to populate a WP site with LMS content for testing and development.

scripts.docker:test: docker compose exec wp-test bash -c 'composer test'
scripts.docker:test:coverage: docker compose exec -e XDEBUG_MODE=coverage wp-test bash -c 'composer test:coverage'
scripts.docker:test:integration: docker compose exec wp-test bash -c 'composer test:integration'
scripts.k6:lifter:smoke: bash scripts/k6-run.sh run --vus 1 --iterations 1 -e THINK_TIME=0 -e ACTION_DELAY=0 lifterlms-stress.js
scripts.k6:learndash:smoke: bash scripts/k6-run.sh run --vus 1 --iterations 1 -e THINK_TIME=0 -e ACTION_DELAY=0 -e LESSON_COUNT=1 -e TOPIC_COUNT=3 -e QUIZ_TOPIC_INDEX=10 learndash-stress.js
